description: This Java source file defines the HttpEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine, and handles synchronous and asynchronous service invocation over HTTP, including serialization/deserialization of context and results, and processing HTTP requests and responses within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HttpEngine
classes.description: A class that manages HTTP-based service execution, including synchronous and asynchronous calls, and handles HTTP request processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously by serializing the context, making an HTTP request, and deserializing the response.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Calls runSync and ignores its result.

methods.name: httpEngine
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests to invoke services, including deserializing context, invoking the service, serializing the result, and writing the response.
